# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

# Figure 1 and Figure S1

Data analysis scripts for re-creating Figure 1 and Figure S1.

# Figure 2

## 2A

Tumor panel

### EXPRESSION

```{r}
sce_TU_tumor <- sce_TU[,sce_TU$analysis_cat == "tumor"]

# Add CD44 tumor expression from T cell panel
sce_T_tumor <- sce_T[,sce_T$analysis_cat == "tumor"]

# Aggregate across cells 
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce_TU_tumor, ids = sce_TU_tumor$PID,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce_TU_tumor)$TU_cluster_channel)

mean_sce_T <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce_T_tumor, ids = sce_T_tumor$PID,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rownames(sce_T_tumor) %in% c("CD44"))

mean_exp_df <- assay(mean_sce, "min_max") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame
mean_exp_df_T <- assay(mean_sce_T, "min_max") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame
mean_exp_df$CD44 <- mean_exp_df_T$CD44[match(rownames(mean_exp_df), rownames(mean_exp_df_T))]
```

```{r}
# 1. MEAN
out_df <- data.frame(PID = unique(sce_TU_tumor$PID))

for(i in colnames(mean_exp_df)){
mean_exp_new <- mean_exp_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = mean(mean_exp_df[[i]])) %>% mutate(cat = ifelse(mean > mean_exp_df[[i]], "low", "high")) %>% rownames_to_column("PID")

out_df[,i] <- mean_exp_new$cat[match(out_df$PID, mean_exp_new$PID)]
}

out_df$status_OS <- sce_TU_tumor$status_OS[match(out_df$PID, sce_TU_tumor$PID)]
out_df$OS_months <- sce_TU_tumor$OS_months[match(out_df$PID, sce_TU_tumor$PID)]

# KAPLAN-MEIER ESTIMATE 
# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(out_df %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = out_df)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1], ratio = fit$obs[1]/fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create output
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% filter(p_adj < 0.05)

cur_surv_plot$result <- ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.05, "UP",
                             ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.05, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "DOWN_trend",NA))))

mean_exp_results <- cur_surv_plot
```

```{r}
# Combined visualization
mean_exp_results$category <- "mean"
median_exp_results$category <- "median"

plot_exp_combined <- rbind(mean_exp_results, median_exp_results)
plot_exp_combined$type <- "expression"
both <- plot_exp_combined %>% group_by(group,direction) %>% count() %>% filter(n > 1) %>% pull(group)
plot_exp_combined$category <- ifelse(plot_exp_combined$group %in% both, "both", plot_exp_combined$category)
plot_exp_combined_fil <- plot_exp_combined %>% group_by(group, category) %>% reframe(p = mean(p), 
                                                                                     result = result, 
                                                                                     type = type, 
                                                                                     ratio = mean(ratio),
                                                                                     direction = direction) %>% unique()

ggplot(plot_exp_combined_fil, aes(x=reorder(group,ratio), y = type, shape = category, col = ratio, size= -log10(p)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16,15,17))+
  new_scale(new_aes = "shape")+
  new_scale(new_aes = "color") +
  geom_point(data = plot_exp_combined_fil,aes(size = -log10(p), shape = category, col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,0,2))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Cox model")+
  coord_flip()
```

### PHENOTYPE

```{r}
# 1. MEAN
PID_tumor_metacluster_names <- colData(sce_TU_tumor) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tumor_metacluster_names,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_area <- colData(sce_TU_tumor) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))
PID_tumor_metacluster_names$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_tumor_metacluster_names$PID, PID_area$PID)]
PID_tumor_metacluster_names <- PID_tumor_metacluster_names %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000))
PID_metagroups <- PID_tumor_metacluster_names %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "tumor_metacluster_names",values_from = "density") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

## MULTIVARIABLE COX MODEL
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = Cox_df %>% colnames,.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(i) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}
colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)
Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)
Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce_TU_tumor$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_TU_tumor$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce_TU_tumor$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_TU_tumor$PID)]
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))
multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)
multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_dens_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))
```

```{r}
# Combined visualization
cox_median <- plot_df_dens_median %>% mutate(sign = p_value < 0.05, result = ifelse(plot_df_dens_median$HR > 1 & plot_df_dens_median$p_value < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(plot_df_dens_median$HR < 1 & plot_df_dens_median$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% mutate(category = "median") %>% arrange(desc(HR))
cox_median$group <- factor(cox_median$group, levels = cox_median$group)
cox_mean <- plot_df_dens_mean %>% mutate(sign = p_value < 0.05, result = ifelse(plot_df_dens_mean$HR > 1 & plot_df_dens_mean$p_value < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(plot_df_dens_mean$HR < 1 & plot_df_dens_mean$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% mutate(category = "mean") %>% arrange(desc(HR))
cox_mean$group <- factor(cox_mean$group, levels = cox_mean$group)

plot_cox_combined <- rbind(cox_mean, cox_median)
plot_cox_combined$type <- "phenotypes"
plot_cox_combined_fil <- plot_cox_combined %>% filter(result != "NOTSIG")
both <- plot_cox_combined_fil %>% group_by(group,result) %>% count() %>% filter(n > 1) %>% pull(group) %>% unfactor()
plot_cox_combined_fil$category <- ifelse(plot_cox_combined_fil$group %in% both, "both", plot_cox_combined_fil$category)
plot_cox_combined_fil <- plot_cox_combined_fil %>% group_by(group, category) %>% reframe(HR = mean(HR), p_value = mean(p_value), result = result, type = type) %>% unique()

ggplot(plot_cox_combined_fil, aes(x=reorder(group,HR), y = type, shape = category, col = HR, size= -log10(p_value)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+

  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
```

### INTERACTION

```{r}
sce_fil <- sce_TU[,!is.na(sce_TU$celltype_combined)]

count_TU <- countInteractions(sce_fil, 
                  group_by = "sample_id", 
                  label = "celltype_combined", 
                  colPairName = "neighborhood", 
                  method = "interaction")

out <- count_TU
out$cellpair <- paste0(out$from_label, "__", out$to_label)
count_out <- out %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(group_by, cellpair, ct) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = cellpair, values_from = ct) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(count_out) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(count_out)) 
colnames(count_out) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(count_out)) 
count_out <- count_out %>% column_to_rownames("group_by")

## Select from "TU" interactions - Heterotypic only
selected_pairs <- (str_detect(str_split(colnames(count_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "TU") &
  (!str_detect(str_split(colnames(count_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,2], "TU"))) & (!str_detect(colnames(count_out), "Unknown"))

count_out_selected <- count_out[,selected_pairs]
count_out_selected <- count_out_selected %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id")
count_out_selected$PID <- sce_TU$PID[match(count_out_selected$sample_id, sce_TU$sample_id)]
count_out_selected_long <- count_out_selected %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:(ncol(count_out_selected)-1), names_to = "pair", values_to = "coef")
```

```{r}
# 1. MEAN
out_df <- data.frame(PID = unique(sce_TU$PID))

for(i in unique(count_out_selected_long$pair)){
count_out_loop <- count_out_selected_long %>% filter(pair == i) %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_coef = mean(coef,na.rm = TRUE)) %>% select(PID, mean_coef) %>% unique()
count_out_loop <- count_out_loop %>% mutate(cat = ifelse(mean_coef < mean(count_out_loop$mean_coef, na.rm = TRUE), "low", "high"))
out_df[,i] <- count_out_loop$cat[match(out_df$PID, count_out_loop$PID)]
}
out_df$status_OS <- sce_TU$status_OS[match(out_df$PID, sce_TU$PID)]
out_df$OS_months <- sce_TU$OS_months[match(out_df$PID, sce_TU$PID)]

# Filter
include <- c("PID", "status_OS", "OS_months", 
             out_df %>% filter(!is.na(status_OS)) %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months) %>% pivot_longer(1:ncol(.), names_to = "int", values_to = "value") %>% group_by(int) %>% dplyr::count(value) %>% dplyr::count(value) %>% mutate(sum = sum(n)) %>% filter(sum > 2) %>% pull("int") %>% unique())
out_df <- out_df[, colnames(out_df) %in% include]

# KAPLAN-MEIER ESTIMATE 
# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(out_df %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = out_df)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1], ratio = fit$obs[1]/fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create output
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% filter(p < 0.05)
cur_surv_plot$result <- ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP",
                               ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "DOWN",NA))
cur_surv_countInt_results_mean <- cur_surv_plot 
```

Myeloid panel

### EXPRESSION

```{r}
sce_MY_myeloid <- sce_MY[,str_detect(sce_MY$celltype_combined, "MY_")]

# Aggregrate across cells
mean_sce_MY_myeloid <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce_MY_myeloid, ids = sce_MY_myeloid$PID,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce_MY_myeloid)$MY_expression_channel)
```

```{r}
# 1. MEAN
mean_exp_df <- assay(mean_sce_MY_myeloid, "min_max") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame

out_df <- data.frame(PID = unique(sce_MY_myeloid$PID))
for(i in colnames(mean_exp_df)){
mean_exp_new <- mean_exp_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = mean(mean_exp_df[[i]])) %>% mutate(cat = ifelse(mean > mean_exp_df[[i]], "low", "high")) %>% rownames_to_column("PID")
out_df[,i] <- mean_exp_new$cat[match(out_df$PID, mean_exp_new$PID)]
}
out_df$status_OS <- sce_MY_myeloid$status_OS[match(out_df$PID, sce_MY_myeloid$PID)]
out_df$OS_months <- sce_MY_myeloid$OS_months[match(out_df$PID, sce_MY_myeloid$PID)]

# KAPLAN-MEIER ESTIMATE 
# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(out_df %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = out_df)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1], ratio = fit$obs[1]/fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create output 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% filter(p_adj < 0.05)
cur_surv_plot$result <- ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.05, "UP",
                             ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.05, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "DOWN_trend",NA))))
mean_exp_results <- cur_surv_plot
```

### PHENOTYPE

```{r}
# 1. MEAN
PID_myeloid_metacluster <- colData(sce_MY_myeloid) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(myeloid_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_area <- colData(sce_MY_myeloid) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))
PID_myeloid_metacluster$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_myeloid_metacluster$PID, PID_area$PID)]
PID_myeloid_metacluster <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000))  
PID_metagroups <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "myeloid_metacluster",values_from = "density") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

## MULTIVARIABLE COX MODEL
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = Cox_df %>% colnames,.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(i) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}
colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)
Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)
Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce_MY_myeloid$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_MY_myeloid$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce_MY_myeloid$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce_MY_myeloid$PID)]

covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames
multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))
multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)
multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_dens_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))
```

```{r}
Cox_df_median$OS_months <- sce_MY_myeloid$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_median),sce_MY_myeloid$PID)]

covariates <- Cox_df_median %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames
multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))
multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_median)
multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_dens_median <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))
```

```{r}
# Combined visualization
cox_median <- plot_df_dens_median %>% mutate(sign = p_value < 0.05, result = ifelse(plot_df_dens_median$HR > 1 & plot_df_dens_median$p_value < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(plot_df_dens_median$HR < 1 & plot_df_dens_median$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% mutate(category = "median") %>% arrange(desc(HR))
cox_median$group <- factor(cox_median$group, levels = cox_median$group)
cox_mean <- plot_df_dens_mean %>% mutate(sign = p_value < 0.05, result = ifelse(plot_df_dens_mean$HR > 1 & plot_df_dens_mean$p_value < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(plot_df_dens_mean$HR < 1 & plot_df_dens_mean$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% mutate(category = "mean") %>% arrange(desc(HR))
cox_mean$group <- factor(cox_mean$group, levels = cox_mean$group)

plot_cox_combined <- rbind(cox_mean, cox_median)
plot_cox_combined$type <- "districts"
plot_cox_combined_fil <- plot_cox_combined %>% filter(result != "NOTSIG")
both <- plot_cox_combined_fil %>% group_by(group,result) %>% count() %>% filter(n > 1) %>% pull(group) %>% unfactor()
plot_cox_combined_fil$category <- ifelse(plot_cox_combined_fil$group %in% both, "both", plot_cox_combined_fil$category)
plot_cox_combined_fil <- plot_cox_combined_fil %>% group_by(group, category) %>% reframe(HR = mean(HR), p_value = mean(p_value), result = result, type = type) %>% unique()

ggplot(plot_cox_combined_fil, aes(x=reorder(group,HR), y = type, shape = category, col = HR, size= -log10(p_value)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16,15,17))+
  new_scale(new_aes = "shape")+
  new_scale(new_aes = "color") +
  geom_point(data = plot_cox_combined_fil,aes(size = -log10(p_value), shape = category, col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,2,0))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Cox model")+
  coord_flip()
```

### INTERACTION

```{r}
sce_fil <- sce_MY[,!is.na(sce_MY$celltype_combined)]

count_MY <- countInteractions(sce_fil, 
                  group_by = "sample_id", 
                  label = "celltype_combined", 
                  colPairName = "neighborhood", 
                  method = "interaction")

out <- count_MY
out$cellpair <- paste0(out$from_label, "__", out$to_label)
count_out <- out %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(group_by, cellpair, ct) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = cellpair, values_from = ct) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(count_out) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(count_out)) 
colnames(count_out) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(count_out)) 
count_out <- count_out %>% column_to_rownames("group_by")

## Select from "MY" interactions - Heterotypic only
selected_pairs <- (str_detect(str_split(colnames(count_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "MY") &
  (!str_detect(str_split(colnames(count_out), "__", simplify = TRUE)[,2], "MY"))) & (!str_detect(colnames(count_out), "Unknown"))

count_out_selected <- count_out[,selected_pairs]
count_out_selected <- count_out_selected %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id")
count_out_selected$PID <- sce_MY$PID[match(count_out_selected$sample_id, sce_MY$sample_id)]
count_out_selected_long <- count_out_selected %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:(ncol(count_out_selected)-1), names_to = "pair", values_to = "coef")
```

```{r}
# 1. MEAN
out_df <- data.frame(PID = unique(sce_MY$PID))
for(i in unique(count_out_selected_long$pair)){
count_out_loop <- count_out_selected_long %>% filter(pair == i) %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_coef = mean(coef,na.rm = TRUE)) %>% select(PID, mean_coef) %>% unique()
count_out_loop <- count_out_loop %>% mutate(cat = ifelse(mean_coef < mean(count_out_loop$mean_coef, na.rm = TRUE), "low", "high"))
out_df[,i] <- count_out_loop$cat[match(out_df$PID, count_out_loop$PID)]
}

out_df$status_OS <- sce_MY$status_OS[match(out_df$PID, sce_MY$PID)]
out_df$OS_months <- sce_MY$OS_months[match(out_df$PID, sce_MY$PID)]

# Filter
include <- c("PID", "status_OS", "OS_months", 
             out_df %>% filter(!is.na(status_OS)) %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months) %>% pivot_longer(1:ncol(.), names_to = "int", values_to = "value") %>% group_by(int) %>% dplyr::count(value) %>% dplyr::count(value) %>% mutate(sum = sum(n)) %>% filter(sum > 2) %>% pull("int") %>% unique())
out_df <- out_df[, colnames(out_df) %in% include]

# KAPLAN-MEIER ESTIMATE 
# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(out_df %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = out_df)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1], ratio = fit$obs[1]/fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create output
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% filter(p < 0.05)
cur_surv_plot$result <- ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP",
                                           ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "DOWN",NA))
cur_surv_countInt_results_mean <- cur_surv_plot 
```
